data.narrative:
Cradle is a Series B biotech company that has raised $102.7M to date across its founding team of five. The valuation analysis draws on a peer universe of 3 public comparables (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private-stage peers in Biotech & Health, with particular focus on same-stage and adjacent-stage companies including Colossal Biosciences, Chai Discovery, and New Limit.

Two triangulation methods prove applicable. Stage-Progression uses the $103M total raised as a proxy base and applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B progression, yielding $195M. Peer-Median anchors to a 3-company comparable set (Colossal, Chai, New Limit) with a median valuation of $3.8B, though with substantial dispersion: the range spans $3.1B to $10.3B. Public-Comp anchoring cannot be executed—the sector median P/S multiple for Biotech & Health is 8.1x across three public tickers, but Cradle's revenue is not disclosed, precluding application of this method.

The two applicable methods produce a wide triangulated range of $166M to $4.4B, with a median implied value of $2.0B. The gap between stage-progression ($195M) and peer-median ($3.8B) reflects substantial uncertainty around Cradle's relative position within the peer cohort and the maturity/valuation premium of its comparable set. Key uncertainties include revenue trajectory, clinical/technical validation stage, and whether peer comparables are truly stage-aligned or represent later-stage capital raises.
